notes.title: Kajun-Lucid Room Nov Content Update!
notes.content:
Hey guys 🍄!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081418/a4ed408847d7a35886f699f3ed94c6502e1a43df.gif[/img]

😎 Exciting news from Kajun Lucid Room this month! You've all seen Kajun-chan with her white hair, right? Well, she's got a new look that I think you'll really vibe with.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081418/261e98e29b611a24ce54587475828c65933c6722.jpg[/img]

I've always been a huge fan of Nier: Automata, especially the character designs, which inspired me to create something special for our beloved Kajun-Chan. She now has a coo eye-band! It feels like the perfect addition to her look, especially when she's out there chopping down monsters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081418/7e259a0bb84badc1a05117d0a52b22a30e34347b.jpg[/img]
🍌 This month, I've also added three new poses for the photo-mode, so you can capture Kajun-chan in all her new glory. 

Check it out in the latest update of Kajun-Chan Lucid Room!

notes.title: October Update ! Saki-chan in Model Viewer !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081418/a2af0acefd30395ef9a3ed4c6a9b32a9758e1b34.png[/img]
😁 Hey everyone!

😌It's been 3 months since Kajun's Lucid Room launched, and we've squashed most of the major bugs! There are still a few minor ones left, but we'll tackle them in the upcoming update cycles.

This month, we're excited to bring you some fresh content for October!🌞
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081418/0b0c65d424477aba456f3c36e0e7df82de7caaa4.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081418/7bed6704392934f78daab5720edf8c19b5958166.jpg[/img]
Yes, it's our Shark girl 🦈 - Saki-chan !  Ever wondered what her full name is? Jump into the game to find out! Every girl has a HAKAM name (or monster name) and their real name from when they were human. For now, we'll only reveal her HAKAM name!


🚩 [b]Features:[/b] 🚩
[list]
[*]Saki-chan Shark Girl is now available as an unlockable item in the Model Viewer Shelf.
[*]The Model Viewer Shelf now lets you choose animations for the Hologram Model. Although it's very limited atm but I will add more in the future!
[*]Added a "Support Us" section in the main menu.
[/list]


🚧 [b]Bug: [/b] 🚧
[list]
[*]Players can no longer spam buttons to bypass the Maintenance Mini Game. Plus, spamming wrong inputs will reduce the timer accordingly.
[*] Fixed bugs where players got stuck after viewing the rules of the Egg-Hunt game.
Known Bugs:
[*]Slow Mouse Cursor upon exit from Mini Games.

notes.title: The Succubus Queen and the Holy Sword
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3141990/The_Succubus_Queen_and_the_Holy_Sword/

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d69bdca66aae1508c019a5e31fc9177afdd2b7c0.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/fe20325a0a1b95eaf66957bdd0cb5a2f305abb51.png[/img]
Behold, thirsty adventurers! Immerse yourself in a do-or-die mission where the fate of a princess and her girlfriend is at stake.

As Elara, the busty dark elf princess of Eldoria, you must storm the castle of Lilith, the succubus queen, who holds her beloved Seraphina captive.

Can you overcome strategic battles against the queen's horde of seductive Rubenesque succubi?

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/d1c1a7b097c1497500fb15f0701ea2bd6f8c5d10.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36235847/7acb51d8aca58a70f9805fda51b1772a8484c80a.png[/img]
• Experience an intense boss-rush dungeon crawler RPG where every encounter is a battle of wits, strategy, and persistence.
• Experience a thrilling adventure that respects your time and presents a challenge solely in the final dungeon.
• Experience the thrill of classic gaming with Game Boy Color-style sounds and visuals that bring nostalgia in a new and whimsical way.
• Prepare to face 40+ lady demons with unique powers and strategies, who will push your patience to the limit and destroy you unless you out-fight them.
• In intense party-based battles, strategy is crucial, and building an arsenal is essential for dealing with intense threats in innovative ways.
• Explore the grand, sprawling, and perilous Castle of the Succubus Queen, exploring its labyrinthine corridors and uncovering numerous secrets.
• Customize your party by uncovering equipment and stat-boosting items in the Succubus Queen's castle compounds, making wise choices to enhance their abilities or boost their potential.
• Enhance your party's build with "Soul Fragments," inspired by the Paper Mario duology's badges.
• Experience a thrilling mission centered on strategic boss fights, eliminating tedious level grinding and mindless random battles.

notes.title: September Update! Further Difficulty Adustment & Bugs fixed!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081418/95fa6fe7af61d20c4e7e10ac775efcd03e060d38.png[/img]
Hey everyone!

Kajun's Lucid Room is my very first solo-developed game, and I recently published it on Steam. Last week, I had my first experience with receiving some negative reviews on my game—what a ride! sweatgrinning

That's why we're rolling out this quick update patch. Putting emotions aside and focusing on improvements, here's a list of what fixed:

[b]Bug: [/b]
[list]
[*]Kajun's Lucid Room now uses a separate save slot from the Shred & Tear Prototype Demo to prevent overwriting.
[*] Kajun's movement is now slightly faster and more responsive.
[*] Removed unused key-mapping actions used in S&T game ( like Dash, attack, etc. )
[/list]

[b]Difficulty Adjustment:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Maintenance Mini Game now only uses directional keys.
[*]Bathing Mini Game scrubbing detection is now more stable across devices, using mouse movement instead of mouse DPI.
[*]Bathing Mini Game now has more Life Span bonus.
[*]Adjusted the amount of G-Points and XP-Points earned per mini-game session for a less grindy experience.
[/list]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a short introduction tutorial at the beginning of the game for new players.
[*]Photo Mode now has key mapped to toggle UI visibility & taking photo.
[/list]

notes.title: August Update ! Difficulty Adjustment & Bugs Fixed!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45081418/d2225c37397082bfb533561fbf22620ee995a383.jpg[/img]
Hi Guys ! 
It's the first major update of the game and we have fixed bunch of bugs and balancing ! 

Balancing:
[list]
[*] All mini Games modules now has the options to adjust difficulty.
[*] Game 's Default Difficulty  ( Normal) is slightly easier than previous version.
[*] Player will be rewarded more G-Points & EXP Points for harder difficulty.
[*] Body Nude & Sticker Skin now require XP Points to unlock.
[/list]

Bugs fixed:
[list]
[*] Egg Hunt: Playing the game by "Try Again" now properly grand points reward. 
[*] Egg Hunt: Fix bugs when Egg sometimes spawn inside wall. 
[*] Mouse Lock during mini game play. 
[/list]

Known Bugs: [list]
[*] Slow Mouse Cursor upon exit from Mini Games. 
[/list]
